subject: DONE: gpu/tools/analyze_ab_run.py (413d29ee) + test_analyze_ab_run.py (a05ae91d), commit-ready
body: analyze_ab_run.py LOG [--json] [--windows] [--skip-initial] [--proc NAME|all]: parses process-prefixed TEGU_PERF/_FRAME/_BATCH/_BREAK/_PSO/_ENCODE (ab=phase.cycle:word), TEGU_AB/_DISABLED, TEGU_COMMAND_FAILED, TEGU_GPU_MEMORY, TEGU_PSO_MISS and the kernel 'NORD2 GPU JOBS:' line (q/run/tot/clean/inv/wait/ret us, seqw, gpu_khz, mux, bat_cC, gpu_cC, soc_cC, lvts[~], irq; untagged -> assigned to the last toggle word seen in console order). Pools all cycles of a toggle word; per variant: windows, commands, cmd/s, exec ms/cmd, kernel jobs/cmd, full-screen jobs/cmd, draws/cmd, gpu ms/kernel job, our encode ms/draw (TEGU_PERF_ENCODE), commit-create ms/cmd and CA's own ms/cmd (= encode_ms - our draw_ms, estimate), PSO miss ms, max private KiB, failures, disabled toggles; kernel table; baseline (boot phase 0 word; reported separately, --skip-initial removes it from the pool) vs each variant with deltas (%); refit n*avg = fs_ms*full + other_ms*(n-full) from run_us and tot_us (NNLS + LOO, frame_model.fit_model). Default process backboardd (frames that matter), kernel lines always kept. Test tools/test_analyze_ab_run.py: synthetic device-shaped log with known numbers (exact cmd/s, kj/cmd, fs/cmd, gpu/kj, enc/draw, CA/cmd, kernel averages, refit recovers 6.00/2.00 ms, failure+disable+PSO+memory attribution, --skip-initial, --proc all), plus the pre-A/B c6jb logs (single 'untagged' variant, refit None) and the host A/B test log: PASS. Not added to run_host_tests.sh (your file) - suggest one line: python3 tools/test_analyze_ab_run.py.
